zh: 挂上一段对话时，给宿主元素命名的那趟遍历每个元素只做一次选择器判断，被移走的子树不再逐个节点查十几张表；切换到一段六百条消息的会话时，皮肤的脚本时间从 66.0 毫秒降到 47.7 毫秒
en: The pass that names host elements now asks one selector test of each element of a mounted conversation, and no longer looks every node of a removed subtree up in a dozen tables; switching to a 600-message session drops from 66.0 ms of the skin's script time to 47.7 ms
